items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: The name 'Dick' appears only in the interviewer's questions ('What about this note about Columbia's tunes, Dick?', 'You got a note here, Dick, for rowing clubs?'). The interviewee never addresses Dick, nor does he mention Dick in his responses. The interviewee refers to himself as 'Frank Netto' at t

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember the one that was running out was Chris, not Chris. No, Sig Christian's his old lady. That's the one you're talking about. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name.

What about this note about Columbia's tunes, Dick? I just wondered if they pushed any tunes. But you, we went over that, didn't we? Yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Crum knew all that. Yeah. We still didn't finish with what happened to the leaders of the band. You and, you and...

Oh, well Bill and I had the band over there and then Bill got sick that, and he went to the hospital. And when they paid me off, Bill, we were splitting the leader price, Bill and I. And when I went to the hospital, and they paid me off that night and they paid me the full salary. And I said to myself, he said, what you looking at? It's so funny. He said, ain't right? He says, ain't that what you been getting all the time? And I didn't say nothing. I said to myself, ain't what I been getting all the time. But…
